[[Sakalo Yawpyawl]] is one of the several [[Grawl]] [[boss]]es that can be found randomly on four selected locations in [[Witman's Folly]].

==Locations==
*[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Witman's Folly}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|"Victory Is Mine!"}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Belly Smash}}
*{{skill icon|Hammer Bash}}
*{{skill icon|Healing Signet}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Grawl Gear]]
*[[Intricate Grawl Necklace]]

==Notes==
*This boss shares only four [[spawn]] points with four other bosses: [[Salani Pippip]], [[Ipillo Wupwup]], [[Karobo Dimdim]], and [[Alana Kepkep]]. This means that a random one of these five will not spawn per map [[instance]].

==Trivia==
*Shares the same family name and skill set as [[Jono Yawpyawl]].
